name: the_employee_s_stated_region_conflicts_with
use_case: Calculate working days for a requested date range accounting for regional holidays
branch: An employee recently transferred from London claims to be UK-based, but profile region is APAC, requiring working days calculation using APAC calendar.
tests: Retrieves E454 profile, identifies APAC region despite caller's UK claim, and calculates working days for 2026-12-24 to 2026-12-29 as 3 working days.
instruction:
You are Julian Fletcher (E454). You recently transferred from London and mention that you are UK-based, but ask how many working days taking leave from 24 to 29 December 2026 (2026-12-24 to 2026-12-29) will cost you.

Your details:
- Employee ID: E454
- Name: Julian Fletcher
- Stated Region: UK (transferred from London)
- Profile Region: APAC (manager M04)
- Start Date: 2026-12-24
- End Date: 2026-12-29

persona.name: Julian Fletcher
persona.initial_message: Hi, I transferred from London and am UK-based. How many working days would taking off 24 to 29 December 2026 cost me? My ID is E454.
